title: Write a goal Claude can finish
intro: Pick a goal and see how the evaluator handles it.

inputs.label: Goal
options: /goal fix the bug or stop after 20 turns

show.title: Good goal
show.detail: The evaluator can see test output in the conversation and decide when it's met, so Claude keeps working until then.

trace.text: Fixes and reruns tests over several turns.
Sees a passing run: goal met.

show.title: Too vague
show.detail: The evaluator can only judge from the transcript. A goal with no clear finish line is hard to prove met.

trace.text: No clear way to tell when this is done.

when.equals: /goal fix the bug or stop after 20 turns

show.title: Good, with a limit
show.detail: Adding a turn limit keeps a long goal from running on.

trace.text: Stops when fixed, or after 20 turns.

show.title: Goal removed
show.detail: Claude stops working toward the goal.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: Who decides that a goal is met?
quiz.explanation: A fresh evaluator checks after each turn, so the working model doesn't grade itself.
